text: こうかんした　＊　つよくなったかい？

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become that way'. つよくなった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. こうかんした　＊ = 'the ＊ that was traded'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい at the end is a soft, friendly way to ask a yes-or-no question, used mostly by men. つよくなったかい = 'has it got stronger?'.
